verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents an API for the Customer Agent to handle requests outside a ticketing system. A changelog entry says the Internal Agent, which configures flows, can be run from your own tools via the API. That suggests some configuration work is reachable programmatically, but nothing documents that every UI capability has an API equivalent, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented API reference or OpenAPI spec, explicit UI/API parity for releases, knowledge, automations, guardrails and connections, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Customer requests come in through the API instead of a ticketing system. Your Customer Agent handles them with the same configurations, tools, and guardrails
let the Internal Agent act without waiting for approval, and run it from your own tools via the API.
Describe the flow you want in natural language - the policies, knowledge, and tool connections it combines - and the Internal Agent configures it.
